  • Airspace & Transport: Regional airspace largely closed — Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan reported closed. Commercial flights mostly grounded; flight‑scan snapshots show hundreds of displaced aircraft.
  • Economy & Markets: Oil prices up and stocks volatile after renewed strikes and pauses (Reuters).
  • Other tactical notes: Iran canceled technical talks participation. Domestic tensions in Iran reported. Multiple sources confirm IDF tunnel clearance.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF removed a 200m terror tunnel; the ceasefire pause is holding for now; one Lebanese official publicly supported normalisation steps.
  • Threat assessment: de-escalating
